bank_letters_amount_confirmed.name: bank_letters_amount_confirmed
bank_letters_amount_confirmed.value: "bank_letters"."amount_fils" is null or ("bank_letters"."confirmed_by" is not null and "bank_letters"."confirmed_at" is not null)

deals_open_unit_uq.name: deals_open_unit_uq
deals_open_unit_uq.where: "deals"."state" not in ('HANDED_OVER', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') and "deals"."unit_id" is not null

deals_open_listing_uq.name: deals_open_listing_uq
deals_open_listing_uq.where: "deals"."state" not in ('HANDED_OVER', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') and "deals"."listing_id" is not null

deals_one_property.name: deals_one_property
deals_one_property.value: ("deals"."deal_type" = 'primary_offplan' and "deals"."unit_id" is not null and "deals"."listing_id" is null) or ("deals"."deal_type" <> 'primary_offplan' and "deals"."listing_id" is not null and "deals"."unit_id" is null)

noc_records_paid_confirmed.name: noc_records_paid_confirmed
noc_records_paid_confirmed.value: "noc_records"."paid_fils" is null or "noc_records"."paid_confirmed_by" is not null

payment_plan_rows_when.name: payment_plan_rows_when
payment_plan_rows_when.value: "payment_plan_rows"."due_on" is not null or "payment_plan_rows"."milestone" is not null

payments_amount_needs_confirmer.name: payments_amount_needs_confirmer
payments_amount_needs_confirmer.value: "payments"."amount_fils" is null or "payments"."confirmed_by" is not null

payments_counted_needs_confirmation.name: payments_counted_needs_confirmation
payments_counted_needs_confirmation.value: "payments"."status" <> 'counted' or ("payments"."amount_fils" is not null and "payments"."confirmed_by" is not null and "payments"."into_escrow")

registrations_issued_needs_number.name: registrations_issued_needs_number
registrations_issued_needs_number.value: "registrations"."status" <> 'issued' or ("registrations"."registry_no" is not null and "registrations"."issued_on" is not null)

signatures_signed_complete.name: signatures_signed_complete
signatures_signed_complete.value: "signatures"."signed_at" is null or ("signatures"."typed_name" is not null and "signatures"."consent" is true and "signatures"."link_used_at" is not null)

signing_envelopes_complete_needs.name: signing_envelopes_complete_needs
signing_envelopes_complete_needs.value: "signing_envelopes"."status" <> 'complete' or ("signing_envelopes"."signed_doc_hash" is not null and "signing_envelopes"."storage_key" is not null and "signing_envelopes"."completed_at" is not null)

spa_tasks_done_needs_who.name: spa_tasks_done_needs_who
spa_tasks_done_needs_who.value: "spa_tasks"."status" = 'open' or ("spa_tasks"."done_at" is not null and "spa_tasks"."done_by" is not null)
